extracted.name: Mug cake
extracted.description: Mug cake I made this recipe for anyone who wants to know how to make a mug cake. I think this recipe is very special to me because, I love baking, especially at such a young age and my family and friends love this recipe so I just decided to share online to see what you guys think of the mug cake... I hope you love it!!!
instruction_lines: Start of by adding your flour, cocoa powder, salt, sugar, and baking powder into a bowl and mix well...
Next, in a separate bowl add your water, oil, milk...
Now add your wet batter in to the dry ingredients...
Now that you have your batter, pour it into a cup that you are going to use to bake your cake...
Place it in the microwave for about 1-2 mins
